meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管好代码工作树和终端,把任务交接给下一个智能体继续做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时开多个代码分支并行干活,还要在智能体之间来回交接任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage worktrees and terminals from the command line, hand tasks off to another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run parallel branches and pass tasks between agents

howto.what: Claude 会用 `orca` 命令行操作 Orca 管理的 worktree、终端、仓库、自动化、artifacts、技能分享和内置浏览器等。执行前它先选定本会话对应的可执行文件,再加载与该版本匹配的指南,然后才运行命令。
howto.when: 当用户说出 "$orca-cli"、"Orca worktree"、"handoff" 等关键词,或要求在工作树里启动 codex/claude、读取或发送 Orca 终端内容时触发。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 在这个仓库里开一个 child worktree
say.note: 会先解析可执行文件并加载版本匹配的指南。

say.text: 读一下我 Orca 终端的最新输出
say.note: 通过 CLI 执行读取/等待终端的命令。

say.text: 把这个任务 handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 借助 Orca 终端完成交接。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing and the embedded browser. It resolves the session's executable, loads the version-matched guide, then runs commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" and similar, or ask to spawn codex/claude in a worktree or read/send an Orca terminal.

say_en.text: Use orca-cli to spawn a child worktree in this repo
say_en.note: Resolves the executable and loads the matching guide.

say_en.text: Read the latest output from my Orca terminal
say_en.note: Runs the read/wait terminal commands via the CLI.

say_en.text: Hand this task off to another agent
